title: Magnetic Pill Button
summary: A primary call-to-action pill that leans toward the pointer as it comes near and fills with colour from the side the pointer entered.
useWhen: Single primary call to action in a dark, sparse product hero for an AI or developer tool
Waitlist or request-access button that should feel responsive before it is clicked
Studio or portfolio site that wants one tactile control on an otherwise still page
Upgrading a flat button hover without adding motion to the rest of the page
techniques: pointer distance to the button edge with smoothstep falloff
clip-path inset sweep chosen per entry side
duplicate label inside the fill layer
transition suppression class for instant resets

whyItWorks.how: The pull is computed from the pointer's distance to the button edge, not its centre. Inside --magnet-radius (90px) a smoothstep falloff scales the offset to 0.32 of the pointer delta (PULL), and the button eases toward it at a lerp of 0.14 per 60Hz frame (LERP). The label moves half as far again (LABEL_PULL 0.16), so the pill reads as having depth.

On pointerenter the script finds the nearest edge of the pill and sets the empty clip to that side, for example inset(0 100% 0 0) for the left, before switching to inset(0). The colour arrives from where the pointer came in and leaves toward where it went out.

The fill layer holds its own copy of the label in ink. The clip-path edge sweeps across both colour and text together, so the label changes from ivory to ink exactly at the edge with no colour transition.

Keyboard :focus-visible shows the full fill and a 2px accent ring. Under (hover: none) the script skips the magnet and the sweep, and CSS renders a solid accent pill with a 0.97 press scale on :active.

The fill enters in 340ms (--fill-duration) on an ease-out and exits in 250ms (--fill-exit-duration) on an ease-in. The rAF loop stops once the button is within 0.05px of its target, so nothing runs while the pointer is away.

directions.name: Luxury
directions.change: Use a thin gold hairline pill on black, cut PULL to 0.18 and LERP to 0.08 for a heavier, slower lean, and fill with a deep champagne tone.

directions.name: Brutalist
directions.change: Drop the radius to 0, fill with solid black on a white page, set LERP to 0.3 so the pull feels snappy, and remove the label parallax.

directions.name: Corporate
directions.change: Keep the sweep but remove the magnet, use the brand blue for the fill, and set --fill-duration to 220ms for a quiet, frequent control.

pitfalls: Measuring the transformed button to compute the pull. The offset then feeds back into the next frame and the button drifts. Measure a static wrapper.
Applying the pointer delta directly. Without the lerp the button twitches with every mouse event and jitter from the sensor shows.
Using the magnet on every button. One magnetic control per view keeps it special and stops the page from feeling unstable.
Running the effect on touch. There is no hover on a phone, so the button would jump on tap. Gate it behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
Pulling too far. Past about a third of the pointer delta the button seems to escape the click.

tunables.name: PULL
tunables.effect: Share of the pointer offset the button moves when the pointer is at its edge.

tunables.name: LABEL_PULL
tunables.effect: Extra offset applied to the label for a layered feel.

tunables.name: LERP
tunables.effect: Damping per 60Hz frame. Lower values feel heavier.

tunables.name: --magnet-radius
tunables.effect: Distance from the button edge at which the pull starts.

tunables.name: --fill-duration
tunables.effect: Time for the fill to sweep in.

tunables.name: --fill-exit-duration
tunables.effect: Time for the fill to sweep out. Keep it shorter than the entrance.

reducedMotion: The button does not move toward the pointer. The fill fades in and out over 160ms instead of sweeping, and keyboard focus still shows the filled state.
